# MakeHardware — network access for the cloud environment
#
# ===========================================================================
# RECOMMENDED: set Network access to **Full**. There is no allowlist to paste.
# ===========================================================================
#
# Full is the right default for this workflow specifically. Sourcing and
# documentation both mean fetching from vendor sites you cannot enumerate in
# advance — with an allowlist, every new manufacturer is a config change
# before the agent can read a datasheet, and the agent's fallback is to ask you
# to go and fetch it by hand.
#
# The trade: a session can reach any domain. Treat any credential you put in
# the environment's variables as exposed to whatever the agent reads.
#
# Nothing below is needed on Full. It is here for the tighter options.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FALLBACK — Custom, if you would rather not run open
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Network access to **Custom**, TICK "Also include default list of common
# package managers", and paste the uncommented lines.
#
# Minimum for the design loop to work at all:

ppa.launchpadcontent.net
*.frame.claudeusercontent.com

#   ppa.launchpadcontent.net
#     KiCad 10 packages. Launchpad serves PPA content from this host. The
#     Trusted preset lists only launchpad.net and the RETIRED ppa.launchpad.net
#     (which no longer connects at all). Without this line apt-get update only
#     warns, still exits 0, and apt-get install kicad silently gives you KiCad
#     7.0.11 from Ubuntu universe — which has no IPC API, so Konnect cannot
#     drive it.
#
#   *.frame.claudeusercontent.com
#     Lets Claude read back the vision boards and reports it publishes as
#     Artifacts.
#
# Then add vendors as you hit them. The agent will name the denied host:
#
# *.ti.com  *.analog.com  *.microchip.com  ww1.microchip.com  *.st.com
# *.nxp.com  *.digikey.com  *.mouser.com  *.snapeda.com  *.samacsys.com
#
# ltspice.analog.com        # only if you set MH_ENABLE_LTSPICE=1
# fal.run  *.fal.ai  api.bfl.ai   # only for a paid image API
# api-inference.huggingface.co    # Hugging Face Inference — vision styling
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOT affected by any of this
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# These are properties of the base image and the GitHub proxy, and hold at
# every network level, Full included:
#
#   * add-apt-repository is broken (python3 is 3.11, python3-apt ships 3.12)
#   * the GitHub API and release web pages 403 for repos not attached to the
#     session, at every network level — the GitHub proxy is independent of the
#     network access level. Release *assets*
#     (/releases/download/<tag>/<file>) and `git clone` of a public repo are
#     served, which is how Konnect installs
#   * the ~5 minute setup budget, 4 vCPU / 16 GB RAM / 30 GB disk
